title: Corydalis decumbens and tetrahydropalmatrubin inhibit macrophages inflammation to relieve rheumatoid arthritis by targeting Fosl2.
authors: Gao, Peng; Yuan, Shuo; Wang, Yanhang; Wang, Yuqi; Li, Xiaoshuang; Liu, Tingting; Zheng, Yongzhe; Wang, Jing; Liu, Dan; Xu, Luzheng; Jiang, Yong; Zeng, Kewu; Tu, Pengfei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分THP靶向转录因子Fosl2抑制巨噬细胞炎症治疗类风湿关节炎，涉及蛋白-DNA互作（Fosl2与AP-1转录）但仅用分子对接辅助，无AI或物理模拟方法，深度不足。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Corydalisdecumbens (Thunb.) (CD) is a traditional Chinese medicine and as a single herb or formula has been used to treat RA for decades. Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a persistent, systemic autoimmune inflammatory disease. However, the anti-inflammatory target, effective constituents and mechanism was unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: The purpose of this study was to identify anti-RA and anti-inflammatory targets of CD, elucidate effective constituents and molecular pharmacological mechanism. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Anti-RA and anti-inflammatory effect of CD were evaluated on CIA-rats and in LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells respectively. The anti-inflammatory target of CD was identified using thermal proteome profiling (TPP). The recombinant Fosl2 protein was expressed and purified and the target-based effective constituents was screened with bio-layer interferometry (BLI) analysis. Combining photoaffinity probe, LC-MS/MS analysis, docking and point mutation, the binding site was confirmed between Fosl2 and THP. Furtherly, immunofluorescence (IF), co-immunoprecipitation (co-IP) were used to research the pharmacological mechanism of THP and the THP-influenced downstream pathways were elucidated by transcriptomics analysis. RESULTS: CD had therapeutic effect on CIA-rats and a significant anti-inflammation on macrophages. Fosl2 was identified as a target of CD and we elucidated the target-based effective constituents was protoberberine-type alkaloids. THP can inhibit inflammation and transcription of AP-1 via targeting Fosl2 on LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells. For mechanism, THP promoted Fosl2 nuclear translocating and interacting with c-Jun. CONCLUSIONS: These findings firstly elucidated the target and effective constituents of CD treating RA, and found that "undruggable target" Fosl2 can be used as therapeutic targets for RA. Meanwhile, our research suggested that THP has a significant potential for the treatment of RA.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：夏天无（Corydalis decumbens (Thunb.)，简称CD）是一种传统中药，作为单味药或复方制剂已被用于治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）数十年。类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种持续性的系统性自身免疫性炎症疾病。然而，其抗炎靶点、有效成分及作用机制尚不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在鉴定CD的抗RA和抗炎靶点，阐明其有效成分及分子药理学机制。材料与方法：分别通过CIA大鼠模型和LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞评估CD的抗RA和抗炎效果。利用热蛋白质组分析（TPP）鉴定CD的抗炎靶点。表达并纯化重组Fosl2蛋白，通过生物层干涉（BLI）分析筛选基于靶点的有效成分。结合光亲和探针、LC-MS/MS分析、分子对接和点突变，确认Fosl2与THP之间的结合位点。进一步采用免疫荧光（IF）和共免疫沉淀（co-IP）研究THP的药理机制，并通过转录组学分析阐明THP影响的下游通路。结果：CD对CIA大鼠具有治疗作用，并对巨噬细胞表现出显著的抗炎效果。Fosl2被鉴定为CD的靶点，我们阐明了基于靶点的有效成分为原小檗碱型生物碱。THP通过靶向Fosl2抑制LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞中的炎症及AP-1转录。机制上，THP促进Fosl2核转位并与c-Jun相互作用。结论：这些发现首次阐明了CD治疗RA的靶点和有效成分，并发现“不可成药靶点”Fosl2可作为RA的治疗靶点。同时，我们的研究表明THP在RA治疗中具有显著潜力。
